OCRelay 1.1.29

FIX: REVIEW PANELS STAY ON YOUR MONITOR

• A review panel no longer grows wider than the screen as values arrive. This was most noticeable on Pelvis US and on narrower or portrait monitors.
• When room is tight, the worksheet image gets smaller first, then long alert lines wrap.
• Dragging the panel wider or narrower still resizes the worksheet image.
